note: Ground-floor salon of the Maison de Couture (B62), seen looking SOUTH toward its street front: rose-pink silk walls with white and gilt mouldings, pale herringbone oak floor. LANDMARK: the huge crystal chandelier over the round tufted rose ottoman. The glazed front door between the two arched shop windows (mannequins inside, as on the facade) leads out to the square; the open double doorway in the left (east) wall leads to the sage-green atelier. Feminine nouns left of x=950, masculine (and chic) right. Zoom: the right arched shop window with its mannequin (window display).
